name: trigpat

entries.desc: declares ABI 2 — the trigger face (1 + la_window_get); the loader accepts {1,2}
linear-memory offset for the host-written msgpack args (config); 0 = refusal
set the bit pattern (mask/value u8, width 1..4096 samples); domain-reject keeps the previous config; defaults mask=0xFF value=0xA5 width=8
the T1 callback: pull one run-length window via la_window_get and answer fire(1)/no-fire(0); pure function of window + config (determinism contract); sample domain only

ops.name: `config`
ops.semantics: set the pattern (mask/value u8, width 1..4096); domain-reject keeps the previous config; defaults mask=0xFF value=0xA5 width=8

ops.name: `trigger_scan`
ops.semantics: 0 = no fire, 1 = fire — pull one window (`la_window_get`) and match; raw i32 callback convention, no marshalling

measured.window_capacity: 4096B buffer (fw window = 512 records x 5B + 16B header = 2576B; headroom documented, board round pending)
